name: obsidian-reasoning-search
description: LLM-reranked free-text search over your vault, using a local OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Apple Foundation Models via apfel, Ollama, LM Studio).

scripts.build: bun build src/main.ts --outfile main.js --format cjs --external obsidian --target browser
scripts.dev: bun build src/main.ts --outfile main.js --format cjs --external obsidian --target browser --watch
